review.title: Z123, peptide panels and A22ED9: scoped genus-reference diagnostics
review.independence_basis: Parent independently inspected the primary-source context plan, exact authored source config, complete native results, all three candidate diffs and six candidate/receipt hashes before canonical application. The common binder, guarded writer, check runner and diagnostic builder received separate read-only review and mutation controls. This is self-review of the resulting bounded technical corrections.
review.summary: Six selected taxonomy occurrences in three whole records now carry source-compatible native genus-reference correspondences. Separate Z-2/Z-3 and SK22/KHED9 stocks remain distinct, Kamptonema remains unnamed at strain level, and all other biology and old history are preserved. Actual applications and per-record command evidence are bound separately; the reference populations do not establish study-stock species or genome identity.
review.scope_description: Declared genus-reference blocks/statuses and their actual source, application, history and validation provenance in exactly three records. Existing scientific assertions and historical reviews are preserved without new whole-record scientific clearance.
review.selection: Three source-reviewed whole records following the independently verified PES shared-path canary: CommunityMech:000342, CommunityMech:000390 and CommunityMech:000406. Six selected taxonomy occurrences; all unselected taxonomy descriptors remain unchanged. This is not the full higher-rank or taxonomy-repair campaign.
limitations: Partial technical assessment with scientific_review:false. Successful database correspondence and scoped validation do not complete a full scientific review, outstanding repair campaign or corpus QC.

Native denominators count named-binomial reference genomes retained by the exact 761d5537 crosswalk at genus rank, not study-stock genomes. Nitratireductor 49/61, Gordonia 450/453 and Bacillus 4981/8737 are majorities across multiple GTDB genera, not unanimity. Kamptonema 5/5 is a thin reference population.

Primary source scope is abstract-only for Z123 and retained main-text passages for the peptide panels and A22ED9. No new complete-paper, supplement, figure, sequence or assembly audit was performed. The local NCBI label/rank observation is stat-bound, not a full database checksum or release certification.

The original three-record route report ran locally at dfe2fe44; source binding/staging and actual isolated M5 application/checks used 23d84a2d. Local native Python was 3.13.12 and M5 native Python 3.13.2. Post-application checks are not a clean-tree run. The mapping_source date is only a file mtime, not a database release.

Z123 polymer/enzyme measurements do not resolve strain-specific enzyme ownership, intermember metabolite flux or complete carbon mineralization. Its three source-designated stocks remain separate and exact species/assemblies remain unresolved.

The peptide record is a C1/C2 processed-biomass panel with an intentionally empty ecological graph. Kamptonema in C2 is not identified as study stock PCC6506. Limnospira ambiguity/candidates and all eukaryotic exclusions remain unchanged; native serialization only reorders unchanged Limnospira notes.

A22ED9 retains distinct SK22 and KHED9 stocks, their 16S accessions, 24-hour assay versus 72-hour resistance contexts, and limits on redox, biosorption, field performance and emergent advantage. Old statements that mapping was unavailable during earlier curation remain historical; current database availability does not resolve exact stock species or genomes.

Native term validation has no reported assertion denominator. Source-snippet matching, generated-page integration, strict historical successor admission and final combined QC are separate from the eight scoped commands per record. No prior scientific finding is closed.

records.label: Separate Z-1, Z-2 and Z-3 genus-reference correspondences

evidence.locator: Abstract reconstructed Z123 membership; retained source-binding primary_contexts
evidence.summary: The primary abstract identifies Nitratireductor Z-1 and two separate Gordonia stocks Z-2/Z-3. Genus-level correspondence is supported without exact species, stock-assembly or stock-specific enzyme inference.

Native filtering gives Nitratireductor 49/61 with three GTDB genera and Gordonia 450/453 with two genera for each distinct stock occurrence. Exact labels and genus ranks are bound to local authority rows; these are reference populations, not stock genomes.
Actual guarded M5 persistence equals the accepted candidate: three declared blocks/statuses and two native inline events, preserving all other scientific content and old history.

assessments.topic: Three source stocks and genus-only authority
assessments.summary: Z-1, Z-2 and Z-3 retain their exact distinct names, terms and notes. Same-genus database correspondence supplies no new species, assembly or enzyme-owner identification.
The 49/61 and 450/453 routes retain their alternative-genus counts and numerical majority limits. Two Gordonia stock occurrences share a reference population without being collapsed into one isolate.

records.label: Separate SK22 and KHED9 genus-reference correspondences

evidence.locator: Retained strain/16S identification and laboratory assay passages; source-binding primary_contexts
evidence.summary: SK22 and KHED9 are separately named Bacillus stocks with retained 16S accessions. Genus-level correspondence does not resolve exact species or assemblies.

Both declared Bacillus occurrences share the native 4981/8737 reference-genome majority across 44 GTDB genera. Exact local genus authority is bound; the alternative breadth and stock/species uncertainty remain explicit.

evidence.locator: actual before/after/inputs, native sidecar and scoped gate triplets
evidence.summary: Actual M5 persistence equals the two-block/status candidate with two appended native events. Every existing scientific value, separate stock/accession and prior history remains unchanged.

Retain positive element-depletion measurements at their assay scope without redox, exclusive-biosorption or emergent-advantage claims. Historical mapping unavailability is distinct from exact biological identity uncertainty.

assessments.topic: Distinct stock identities and historical uncertainty
assessments.summary: SK22 and KHED9, their 16S accessions and genus-only notes remain intact. Current database computability supersedes only prior mapping unavailability and does not identify either exact species or genome.
The 4981/8737 majority is not unanimity and does not establish that either stock belongs to a specific GTDB species. Each distinct occurrence receives the same bounded genus-reference correspondence.

assessments.summary: The accepted bytes, actual native history and seven scoped validators bind the limited correction. Assay durations, concentration contexts, mechanisms and all historical scientific dispositions are preserved without new full-record clearance.
